connection_condition: Examination.ID carries the patient identifier and corresponds to Patient.ID
description: An examination is a component event of a patient; examination findings cannot be interpreted without the patient record they belong to.

connection_condition: Laboratory.ID carries the patient identifier and corresponds to Patient.ID
description: A laboratory test record is a component measurement event of a patient; its analyte values are meaningless without the patient they describe.

connection_condition: the diagnosis is stored as free text inside the patient record itself; no separate disease dimension table exists
description: The disease diagnosis is an attribute carried on the patient record rather than a distinct entity that could be joined to it.
SLE is one of the disease categories occurring as a value of the patient diagnosis vocabulary, so its value domain is a subset of all diagnosis labels rather than a peer of them.
Age is derived from the birth date; at year granularity it is the current year minus the year of the birth date, so it is a computed metric rather than a stored column.

connection_condition: Patient.Diagnosis and Examination.Diagnosis both hold free-text disease labels drawn from an overlapping vocabulary and describing the same patient identifier
description: The patient-level diagnosis and the examination-stage diagnosis express the same business concept, a disease label for a patient, but differ in granularity: the examination-stage value records the assessment at that examination and is unrecorded for most examinations.

connection_condition: the titer is a column on the examination record
description: The antinuclear antibody titer is a finding that is a component of an examination; it has no meaning apart from the examination it was measured at.

connection_condition: the pattern code is a column on the examination record
description: The ANA staining pattern is a finding that is a component of the same examination record as the antibody titer.

connection_condition: one column per antibody isotype on the examination record
description: Anti-cardiolipin antibody levels are findings that are components of an examination, recorded as one column per isotype.

connection_condition: one column per screening test on the examination record
description: The coagulation inhibitor screening results are findings that are components of an examination, recorded as one column per test.

connection_condition: the grade is a column on the examination record
description: The degree of thrombosis is a finding that is a component of an examination record.

connection_condition: both are autoantibody results for the same patient, recorded on different tables and at different granularity
description: The antinuclear antibody assay is the broad screening test for autoantibodies while the specific extractable nuclear antigen antibodies are the follow-up tests of the same autoantibody family; they are related clinically but grounded in different tables.

connection_condition: both are recorded on the same examination record for the same patient
description: Anti-cardiolipin antibodies and the lupus-anticoagulant screening tests are both antiphospholipid-related findings measured on the same examination and together characterise a patient's antiphospholipid status.

connection_condition: both are recorded on the same examination record for the same patient
description: Coagulation inhibitor positivity and the recorded degree of thrombosis are related expressions of the same patient's thrombotic status.
